items.title: Gold dips for fourth session as oil rally fans inflation concerns
items.summary: GOLD eased for a fourth session on Wednesday as higher oil prices stoked inflationary concerns, while investors looked ahead to next week's Federal Reserve policy meeting for clues on the future path of interest rates.

items.title: Gold prices near Rs 1.47 lakh/10 grams, silver falls by Rs 1,144/kg as traders await Fed rate signals. What lies ahead?
items.summary: Gold prices edged lower while silver fell on MCX as investors awaited the US Federal Reserves upcoming policy decision for clues on interest rates. Traders expect rates to remain unchanged in October, with a possible hike in December. Analysts say dollar strength may cap golds upside, while central bank buying supports longer-term prices.

items.title: Gold slips as investors await Fed rate signals
items.summary: Gold prices fell slightly as investors monitored the Federal Reserve's major interest rate decision. The anticipated meeting will provide key insights into future economic policies. Economists expect the Fed to hold rates steady, emphasizing inflation concerns. The Bank of Japan is also projected to raise interest rates in December. Other precious metals, including silver and platinum, experienced minimal changes during this period.

items.title: Fed sneezes, but emerging markets aren't catching a cold yet
items.summary: Emerging markets have developed stronger immune systems. US debt dynamics are deteriorating and the Federal Reserve has started hiking interest rates, yet EM appears under no pressure to follow suit. The US has sneezed, but EM isn't catching the proverbial cold.
